data.long_meaning: Rooted in the Arabic language, Maawa means kindness and benevolence. This beautiful name is derived from the Arabic word 'mawwa', which signifies love and affection towards others. In Islamic tradition, Maawa symbolizes the highest form of spiritual development, characterized by compassion, empathy, and selflessness. The name Maawa carries the meaning “Kindness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maawa usually hope their child will grow to embody kindness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
